title: PicAudioPluginManifest
description: Formal manifest specification for PicAudio / Parakeet dynamic C-ABI plugins.

id.description: Unique reverse-domain identifier for the plugin.

version.description: Semver version string of the plugin.

description.description: Brief description of the plugin and its features.

targetApiVersion.description: SDK API version targeted by the compiled binary.

capabilities.description: List of capability extensions implemented by the plugin.

actions.description: Optional list of custom action buttons displayed on the plugin card.

entryPoint.description: Optional custom shared library file name (e.g. libspectrum.so, spectrum.dll).

minHostVersion.description: Optional minimum PicAudio host version requirement.
